Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are currently seeking a Marketing Specialist to join our Enterprise Marketing team in Toronto.

What your team does:

This role sits with Events and Community, where the highest volume of vendor, supplier and contract activity lives, and supports the full Enterprise Marketing team on procurement, contracts and budget.

Who you are:

The Marketing Specialist is the operational and administrative backbone of Enterprise Marketing. The role owns the mechanics that keep our events and community programmes moving: managing project plans and timelines in Asana, raising and tracking purchase orders in Coupa, shepherding vendor and partner contracts through legal and procurement, and owning the budget tracker so committed and remaining spend is always current and visible.

This is a role for someone who is energised by making complicated things run smoothly, who is comfortable chasing people politely and persistently, and who wants a broad view of how an enterprise marketing function actually operates before specializing.

What you’ll work on:

Event Project Management: Build and maintain project plans, timelines and task boards in Asana for events, sponsorships and community programmes. Keep owners, due dates and milestones accurate, run the recurring status cadence — planning meetings, stand-ups, status updates and post-event retrospectives — and surface slipping items and risks early.

Budget Management: Own the budget tracker. Track spend against budget by event and programme, reconcile actuals to forecast with Finance, monitor commitments and accruals, and give the Sr. Manager and Sr. Director a current, trusted view of committed and remaining budget at any point in the year.

Procurement & Coupa: Raise, submit and track purchase requisitions and purchase orders in Coupa. Onboard new suppliers, resolve blocked or rejected requisitions, match invoices to POs, chase approvals, and act as the team's first point of contact for anything Coupa-related.

Contracts & Vendor Management: Route vendor, venue, sponsorship and partner agreements through legal, procurement, privacy and security review. Track where every agreement sits, flag renewal and expiry dates, maintain the contract register, and gather the information reviewers need so agreements are not delayed by missing detail.

Accounting & Finance Coordination: Work with Finance and Accounts Payable on invoicing, payment queries, vendor set-up, month-end close inputs and expense reconciliation. Resolve discrepancies between what was contracted, ordered and invoiced.

Events & Community Logistics: Support event delivery end to end: registration lists, shipping and inventory, supplier and venue bookings, attendee communications, on-site materials and post-event wrap-up. Travels roughly 3-5x per quarter across the GTA & US to provide on the ground support for key events.

Stakeholder Coordination: Act as a point of contact for internal stakeholders and external vendors on event timelines, deliverables and approvals, and make sure requests going to design, video or content are complete before handoff.

Team Operations & Process: Keep shared drives, asset libraries, distribution lists, team calendars and the marketing calendar organized and current. Document and maintain recurring processes — procurement, contract routing, budget reporting, event run-of-show — so they are repeatable. Turn retrospective learnings into concrete changes to how the next programme runs.

Administration: Act as a general administrative partner to the Sr. Director, Enterprise Marketing and the wider leadership group.

Other duties as assigned.

What good looks like:

No event, sponsorship or programme is delayed by a purchase order, contract or approval that was not moved in time.

Budget is never a question mark. Committed and remaining spend is current, reconciled and available on request.

Anyone on the team can find the status of any event, contract or budget line in Asana or the tracker without asking.

Invoices, POs and contracts reconcile cleanly, and Finance is not chasing us.

Managers spend materially less time on administration, and that time shows up in strategic and pipeline work instead.

What you may have:

3-5 years in an events, marketing operations, procurement or administrative coordination role. Candidates stepping across from adjacent operational or finance-adjacent roles are welcome.

Budget tracking and management experience is required — owning a tracker, reconciling actuals to forecast, and reporting on spend.

Hands-on experience with a financial or procurement platform is required — Coupa specifically is a strong advantage; comparable systems (SAP Ariba, NetSuite, Workday, Concur) transfer well.

Hands-on experience with a project management platform is required — Asana specifically is a strong advantage; Monday, Wrike, Smartsheet or Jira transfer well.

Strong spreadsheet skills, including formulas, pivot tables and reconciliation.

Exposure to contract routing and legal, procurement or privacy review processes.

Exceptional organization and follow-through. The role succeeds or fails on the ability to hold many small open loops and close every one of them.

Clear, calm written communication and the confidence to chase senior stakeholders and external vendors without friction.

Discretion with commercial and contractual information.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice .

Altis is hiring a full-time Digital Marketing & Demand Generation Specialist in Toronto, with hybrid work available in Toronto or Ottawa. The role pays $75,000 to $90,000 CAD a year and reports to the VP, Marketing. The specialist generates employer and candidate leads through paid advertising, search visibility, content, landing pages, and conversion work. The position calls for three to five years of hands-on digital marketing experience and a record of measurable lead-generation campaigns.
The role combines campaign execution with the measurement work that keeps a growth programme accountable. Altis needs someone who can work across marketing, recruitment, sales, content, design, and outside partners while turning performance data into practical changes. The published role also names Google Ads, paid social, SEO, GA4, CRM data, CMS work, and landing-page optimisation as part of the job.

Role: Digital Marketing & Demand Generation Specialist
Employer: Altis
Location: Toronto, Ontario, with hybrid Toronto or Ottawa work
Employment type: Full-time
Pay: $75,000 to $90,000 CAD per year

Lead generation and campaign work
The specialist builds qualified employer and candidate leads through paid campaigns, organic search, content, and landing pages. Campaign work includes Google Ads, LinkedIn or other paid social channels, audience decisions, messaging, and conversion improvements.
Altis also expects the role to improve the visibility of its website and content in conventional search and AI search environments. The work connects acquisition activity to the next step in the funnel, so landing-page structure and website conversion sit beside media buying rather than apart from it.

Manage paid advertising and lead-generation campaigns
Create and improve content and landing pages
Improve organic and AI search visibility
Evaluate marketing technology and conversion opportunities

Measurement and team partnerships
GA4, analytics, CRM data, and campaign reporting give the specialist the evidence needed to assess performance. The position includes tracking results, identifying weak points, and changing campaigns or pages when the data supports a different approach. The salary range and role scope are detailed in the published role details.
Daily work crosses Sales, Recruitment, Content, Design, external partners, and the marketing function. Clear writing and organised project work matter because campaign changes need to be explained, measured, and carried through several teams.
Experience and working knowledge
Applicants need three to five years of digital marketing experience, including measurable lead-generation results. The role names Google Ads, paid social, SEO, GA4, CMS platforms, and landing-page optimisation as core experience areas. B2B lead generation, marketing automation, conversion rate optimisation, and experience with Canadian or US audiences are useful additions.
Webflow experience is an asset, as are relevant certifications. Strong writing, analytical judgement, organisation, and collaboration support the technical requirements. These capabilities give the specialist a practical route from campaign planning to a reported business result.
Toronto-based hybrid work
The job is anchored in Toronto and allows hybrid work in Toronto or Ottawa. Toronto roles in marketing roles cover campaign, communications, and growth functions across the region. This position is specifically filed with digital marketing opportunities.
The GTA location places the specialist close to the employer, recruitment, and client conversations that shape campaign priorities. The work remains digital, but the role depends on regular coordination with people responsible for sales, hiring, content, design, and partner delivery.
Applications should include evidence of lead-generation campaigns, the channels used, and the measures that improved. A clear account of Google Ads, paid social, SEO, analytics, and landing-page work will help connect past results to the role's stated responsibilities.
Altis lists this as a full-time role with a $75,000 to $90,000 CAD annual salary range. The Toronto position carries a November 21, 2026 application deadline, and the application page identifies the role as a live opening.
Apply for this role
Applicants should have a current resume and concrete campaign examples ready, including measurable lead-generation, paid media, search, analytics, or conversion results. The application also calls for a clear account of the tools used and the teams involved.

Job description:

Who we are

LD Human Resources provides custom HR solutions with in-house consulting and virtual support for small to mid-sized organizations. We work with our clients to improve their team productivity, organizational structure, company culture, and employee relations, which translates into increased profitability. We also ensure the organization is HR compliant, so it remains protected.

At LD Human Resources, we strive to help business owners and HR leaders develop a solid HR foundation, building on the resources they have and aligning the team’s performance with their organization’s short- and long-term objectives.

We believe people are an organization’s most valuable asset – they are the competitive edge! With the right people in the right roles and motivated with a shared purpose, our clients experience accelerated business results.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Marketing & Business Development Coordinator to support the marketing and business development activities of our growing HR consulting firm. This role is ideal for a creative, organized, and relationship-minded individual who is eager to gain hands-on experience in digital marketing, content creation, partner relationship management, and event coordination within a professional services environment. This is not a sales or lead-generation role; the business development focus is on nurturing our existing networking relationships and planning our event presence.

The ideal candidate is curious, adaptable, organized, and detail-oriented, with strong written communication skills, a passion for marketing, and a natural ability to build and maintain professional relationships. They are proactive, collaborative, and excited to contribute ideas while learning in a fast-paced and supportive environment.

We are a busy and growing HR consulting practice, and this is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys thinking outside the box, takes initiative, and wants to build a career in marketing and business development. As the successful candidate grows into the role, they will take on increasing ownership of our marketing and business development functions.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Marketing

· Assist with the development and execution of marketing campaigns that support brand awareness and business growth

· Create, schedule, and publish social media content including posts, reels, graphics, newsletters, and blogs using approved branding templates

· Support the creation of HR-focused content for social media, email marketing, and website updates

· Research marketing trends, audience engagement strategies, and content ideas to support ongoing initiatives

· Collaborate with leadership on creative marketing campaigns and promotional strategies

· Monitor and support online engagement by responding to comments, messages, and inquiries in a professional and timely manner

· Assist with website updates, content management, and maintaining brand consistency across digital platforms

· Support the coordination and promotion of webinars, training sessions, and company initiatives

· Assist with the design and coordination of marketing materials and promotional assets

· Maintain and update online business profiles, directory listings, and marketing databases

Business Development & Events

· Follow up with networking partners, referral partners, and professional contacts after meetings and events to nurture relationships and keep LD Human Resources top of mind

· Maintain an up-to-date partner and contact tracker in our CRM, logging interactions, follow-up dates, and next steps

· Research and track upcoming industry events, conferences, association functions, and networking opportunities, and maintain a shared events calendar

· Help plan and manage event participation, including registrations, logistics, sponsorship or booth coordination, promotional materials, and pre- and post-event communications

· Prepare post-event summaries capturing key contacts, takeaways, and follow-up actions

· Assist in the creation of proposals and presentations based on client needs

· Conduct research to identify potential partnerships, collaboration opportunities, and audience growth strategies

· Assist with internal projects, company culture initiatives, and special events as required

Qualifications:

· Completed a program in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, or a related field

· 2+ years' experience in marketing, business development, or event coordination considered an asset

· Proficient in MS Office, Sharepoint, and Mailchimp with strong skills in spreadsheets and presentation tools; experience with a CRM is an asset

· Working knowledge of Instagram and LinkedIn; experience with Canva, CapCut, and social scheduling tools is an asset

· Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with strong collaboration and research capabilities

· Confident building professional relationships, with consistent follow-through on commitments and next steps

This is an exciting position at a fast-moving agency that is focused on challenging industry norms and developing programs that are best in class.

• Highly empathetic, positive, respectful and competitive

• Excellent communication skills to be the glue between clients and our operations team. Strives to do good for their clients and provide them a stellar customer experience.

• 3+ years of experience reporting on advanced marketing campaigns, including data storytelling
• Proven track record of upselling and driving growth through strategic client partnerships
• Experience in a marketing agency is strongly preferred

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Execution & Program Management

• Coordinate with internal teams, using performance marketing knowledge to clearly outline work to supporting departments to ensure tasks are being completed in a successful and timely manner
• Hold regular meetings, discussions, and brainstorms with different teams to optimize campaigns and hit KPIs

Client Leadership & Reporting

• Build and nurture strong client relationships, fostering trust and positioning yourself as a strategic partner
• Proactively identify and solve client challenges, leading with expertise and confidence while involving Account Directors when necessary for contentious issues
• Lead client reporting meetings, effectively communicating data-driven insights and strategic recommendations
• Confidently create reporting and strategy presentation frameworks with a logical flow, speaking to multiple sections during presentations
• Create and highlight strategic recommendations through storytelling and harnessing strong service knowledge
• Upsell services (where beneficial to the client)

New Client Setups

• Partner with your clients to quickly understand their business, industry, and competitors
• Develop and implement budgets aligned with clients’ key business objectives, ensuring efficient resource allocation throughout the year
• Manage and work with various departments to set up, oversee and launch new digital marketing services

Our team is comprised of passionate, talented, creative and hard-working people that put our clients first. We know our work matters and go to work every day with a sense of purpose.
